::: {#exm-bayes-proportion-stan}
#### The Bernoulli model fitted with Stan

The data and the [uniform prior](bayesian-inference.qmd#def-flat-prior) are those of [the JAGS example](#exm-bayes-proportion).
The Stan program declares the data and the parameter with their types and ranges,
and the `model` block states the [prior](bayesian-inference.qmd#def-prior) and the [likelihood](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-lik):

```{r}
#| label: stan-proportion
#| code-fold: false
bernoulli_stan <- "
data {
  int<lower=0> N;
  array[N] int<lower=0, upper=1> y;
}
parameters {
  real<lower=0, upper=1> p;
}
model {
  p ~ beta(1, 1);
  y ~ bernoulli(p);
}
"
stan_fit <- rstan::stan(
  model_code = bernoulli_stan,
  data = list(N = length(y), y = y),
  chains = 2,
  warmup = 1000,
  iter = 5000,
  seed = 1,
  refresh = 0
)
stan_draws <- as.matrix(stan_fit, pars = "p")[, "p"]
stan_summary <- rstan::summary(stan_fit, pars = "p")$summary
```
:::
